## Body

pij-developed-parakeet held performance/receipt only as a quiet seat for pij-multiple-nightingale's PRD 008 req-09 spawn-counter observation around one pod up. It loaded the requested skills, sent no peer messages, and ran no shell commands before the close-time memory request. It collected no counter, CPU, RSS or launch-rate readings and issued no verdict; this seat's presence is not proof that req-09 passed. The parent owns any measurement receipts.

The memory lookup and write are closeout activity, not pod-up measurements. This receipt-only session does not supersede other performance instances' reviews or AFTER obligations. When opening an indexed memory note, pass its slug without the .dd.md suffix; the filename form refused with E-RS-MEMORY-NOTE-MISSING here.
